narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict expands with kinetic exchanges, a Hormuz blockade persisting through 2026, and Israel opening a two-front war. The breakdown of the 'one-and-done' thesis and active military engagements are driving a broad de-risking across equities and commodities.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures, long WTI crude oil calls with strike above $90, and buy gold as a hedge against further escalation.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The EIA's extended blockade timeline through Q3 2026 and Kuwait's pipeline bypass discussions confirm a structural supply disruption. Despite diplomatic noise, capital is pricing in sustained high oil prices, with WTI forecast raised to $88.32 and real economic damage from the blockade.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures, long energy sector ETFs, and short consumer discretionary stocks to hedge against oil-driven inflation.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Divergence
narratives.summary: While BTC sells off on macro risk-off, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure continue, evidenced by Janus Henderson's $300B+ partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs. This signals a secular trend of real asset tokenization, decoupling from short-term crypto price volatility.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate ENA tokens and long tokenization-focused DeFi protocols; short BTC futures as a tactical macro hedge.
